passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Cenostigma pluviosum (DC.) Gagnon & G.P.Lewis.
The native range of this species is Peru to Brazil and NW. Argentina. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome. It is used as a medicine.
